notes.title: Update 1.0.5: New Languages + Fixes and New Features
notes.notes: [p][i][b]Noble Kings,[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Today we bring you joyful news: The Kingdom now speaks in many more tongues! [b]Korean, Japanese, French, Brazilian Portuguese, [/b]and [b]Polish[/b] have been added to the game, a change inspired by the many noble players from these lands. We’ve heard your voices and are proud to make your royal experience even finer![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/c71a779857531f57cb8d5d18130b742912e3c900.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Simply head to the main menu and change the language at will! If you happen to spot a mistranslation, a strange phrase, or a term more cursed than a graveyard demon… do let us know on [b]Discord[/b], [b]Reddit[/b], or right here in the [b]Steam Discussions[/b]. Your royal insight helps us polish the scrolls![/p][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/4660ae09fc837541e8ddf3d203c0a796192b2515.gif"][/img][b]Fixes & Features![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]But that's not all, fellow royal friends! This update also brings a fresh round of [b]fixes and features[/b] to your realm:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the option to open the Encyclopedia during an active run via the Pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]The Pause menu now displays the current Threat Level modifiers and selected Advisors.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now creates a backup save file to prevent rare cases of save corruption.[/p][/*][*][p]Efficient Processing upgrade for the Mill and Forge now use 2 raw resources instead of 3 to produce 2 advanced resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Trees and level scenery are now correctly preserved when using mid-run saves.[/p][/*][*][p]The game will remain paused if a pending reward is collected while paused.[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture Stores will now save the amount of Town Denarii earned to mitigate potential losses in case of spontaneous run termination[/p][/*][*][p]Advisors' abilities can now be activated during pause (same as King's abilities)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reworked [b]King’s Gaze[/b], resolving crashes and deactivation issues related to the [b]Monument to the King’s Gaze[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings constructed before a mid-run save are now eligible for upgrades as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rounding errors that occasionally prevented purchases or sales despite having enough resources.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Free Housing[/b] and [b]Piggy Bank[/b] artifact refunds are now correctly retained across mid-run saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Training bonuses now properly apply to units inside barracks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Griffins[/b] now correctly benefit from the [b]Lion Circus Versatility[/b] upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ruin Scouts[/b] can now produce and deploy regardless of the current battlefield unit limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Castle damage from [b]Giant’s Bedding[/b] now properly interacts with [b]King Leonid’s “Last Resort”[/b] quest and the [b]Broken Penny[/b] artifact.[/p][/*][*][p]Building upgrades that grant morale or instant effects now activate without needing to refocus the [b]King’s Gaze[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the gallery picture obtained for beating Ascension 10 not displaying.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized text rendering performance.[/p][/*][*][p]A few UI improvements for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More royal news shall come soon, but worry not, noble friends: we haven’t forgotten the questions you sent us for the [b]QnA with the developers[/b]! The scribes are sharpening their quills, and answers shall begin arriving next week![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/5f76c9d0bc9851faab26e7060f0d1ad3df390b10.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Until then… make your Kingdom proud! [b]HUZZAH![/b][/p][p][b]~ The Hypnohead Devs[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow us or join our communities:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][url="https://www.twitter.com/tkiwgame"]Twitter[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/thekingiswatching.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/TheKingIsWatching/"]Reddit[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/7yf97dNPV2"]Discord[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4, King Leo and Lesson Learned
notes.notes:
[p][i][b]Noble Kings,[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Today we want to address the recent balancing changes to [b]King Leo the Wise[/b] and share some insight into our thinking, alongside a few additional adjustments.
[i](If you're here just for the patch notes, feel free to scroll down. But we'd really appreciate it if you took a moment to read this message.)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Kingdom Off to a Glorious Start[/b][/h3][p]It’s been just a few weeks since [i][b]The King is Watching[/b][/i] launched, and we’re overwhelmed with the response. Many of you have already poured countless hours into the game, conquered high Threat Levels, and shared your wild, creative builds with us. Your enthusiasm has been nothing short of inspiring, and it makes us even more determined to keep building upon this world: more content, more Kings, more units.[/p][p][/p][p]But before expanding the kingdom, we need to strengthen its foundations.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Improving the Foundation[/b][/h3][p]Over the past weeks, we’ve mobilized everyone—seriously, everyone. We’ve spoken with nearly every GameMaker developer we could find, and we’re now in direct contact with the engine’s creators. Together, we’ve made huge strides in identifying technical issues, from crashes to performance. Some bugs still remain, but we’re confident that the new [b]mid-run saving system[/b] is a massive step forward for the stability and playability of the game.[/p][p]That said, there are two big areas left to improve:[/p][list][*][p]⚖️ [b]Fixing critical balance issues[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Clarifying UI and core mechanics[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We started with balance…and that leads us to Leo.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Problem with Leo[/b][/h3][p]We’ll be honest: we didn’t balance [b]King Leo the Wise[/b] properly. He was simply too strong. Here's why:[/p][list][*][p]His [b]first ability[/b] had an extremely short cooldown, enabling frequent blueprint sales.[/p][/*][*][p]Selling blueprints rapidly boosted [b]morale[/b], which in turn [b]greatly increased unit damage and resource production[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Players could [b]bypass early-game resource management entirely[/b], a system that’s supposed to be a core part of the challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]On top of that, Leo has one of the best Gaze upgrades and can [b]spawn free units on cooldown[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We want each King to offer unique bonuses and a meaningful challenge. Some will naturally be stronger than others. And we love seeing you break the game with wild builds, whether intentional or not. But Leo was on an entirely different level. Not just compared to existing Kings, but even those we’re planning to introduce in the future.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]"Why Not Just Buff Everyone Else?"[/b][/h3][p]Trust us, we considered it. But buffing everything to match Leo would cause runaway [b]stat inflation[/b] and break the balance of the game in other areas. It would also make it far harder to design future content. So a nerf was necessary.[/p][p][/p][p]We hate nerfing things. And our goal was to do it [b]just once[/b]. But after reviewing your feedback, we agree: we went [b]too far[/b]. This update includes a revised, more balanced version of Leo and several other changes to improve the experience overall.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h3][p][b]King Leo the Wise[/b]’s third ability resource costs have been reverted:[/p][list][*][p]1st use: Wheat 200, Wood 200 → [b]Wheat 100, Wood 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p]2nd use: Wheat 400, Wood 400 → [b]Wheat 200, Wood 200[/b][/p][/*][*][p]3rd use: Flour 250, Metal 250 → [b]Flour 100, Metal 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p]4th use: Flour 600, Metal 600 → [b]Flour 300, Metal 300[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]First ability[/b] cooldown reduced from [b]40s → 30s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the functionality of artifacts applying productivity seals for [b]Threat Level 8+[/b] runs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Steam achievements[/b] for completing the game on [b]Threat Level 10[/b] with each King.[/p][/*][*][p]Made various localization and text improvements across multiple languages.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]A Final Word[/b][/h3][p]We want to sincerely thank you for your feedback. Some of it was tough to read, but it showed just how passionate this community already is about [i]The King is Watching[/i]. We share that passion with you, and we’re learning every day how to better shape this game together.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ve helped us learn a valuable lesson: [b]don’t nerf that hard[/b]. We hope future updates will bring only joy, chaos, and crown-worthy moments.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your love and support!
~ Hypnohead[/b][/p]

notes.title: Mid-Run Saving is here with Update 1.0.3!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Noble Kings![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today we bring news you’ve long awaited: [b]Mid-Run Saving Is Here![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYnM5c3VlZnJuM25ibHU3d3ZrZzBnbmhrcmcya2VkcXdvN3F0b2kzOSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/GmIy7JVNghdG3jCtVF/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each time you complete a wave, the game will [b]automatically save[/b] your progress. You can now safely choose “Quit and Save” from the pause menu, then return to your kingdom later exactly where you left off.[/p][p][/p][p]This improvement comes alongside the[b] 1.0.3 Update[/b], with even more balance, QoL, and technical improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update 1.0.3 Changes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Mid-Run Saves[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Each time you complete a wave, the game automatically saves your progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Safely select [b]"Quit and Save"[/b] from the pause menu and resume your kingdom exactly where you left off.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Technical Improvements and QoL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash related to particle systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Crystal Castle and Balloon Bomber units can now be moved in and out of barracks. The "Comfy Bed" artifact now allows recruiting more of these troops per building.[/p][/*][*][p]Alchemists and the Witch boss now correctly apply production slowdown to buildings with thrown bottles.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the Dragon boss modifier (-50% spell damage) not calculating correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Spell damage multiplier now shows 100% if no modifiers are applied.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p][b]Spells[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fireworks duration increased from 8s → 12s.[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary Fireworks duration increased from 10s → 18s.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bosses and Troops[/b][/p][p][b]Graveyard Golem:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 33,000 → 36,000[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Damage: 280 → 330[/p][/*][*][p]Fallen Soldiers spawned: 8 → 16[/p][/*][*][p]Zombies spawned: 8 → 12[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Malathrax:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 23,000 → 26,000[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Damage: 300 → 330[/p][/*][*][p]Fireball Damage: 70 → 100[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Venoxia:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Attack Damage: 220 → 250[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bat:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 35 → 75[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Damage: 7 → 9[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Whipman:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 60 → 120[/p][/*][*][p]Whip Cooldown: 3s → 1.5s[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Madman:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 70 → 100[/p][/*][/list][p][b]All Druids:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Transformation time: 20s → 12s[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maya Reaper:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 8,000 → 6,000[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maya Pikeman:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 10,000 → 8,000[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Maya Bamboo Warrior:[/b][/p][list][*][p]HP: 8,000 → 7,000[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Kings[/b][/h3][p][b]Brezhnius:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heal Ability: 500 HP → 1,000 HP[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Leonid:[/b][/p][list][*][p]First quest required Castle HP: 10 → 30[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Leo:[/b][/p][p][b][i]Developer Comment:[/i][/b][i]
We don't plan any further nerfs for the Kings. However, we acknowledge that we didn't balance Leo optimally from the start—his ability turned out to be much stronger than intended.[/i][/p][p][i]We completely agree that buffing underperforming characters is a better approach overall, and that's the direction we'll be taking moving forward. Rest assured, no additional major nerfs are planned beyond this adjustment.[/i][/p][list][*][p]First ability cooldown increased from 1s → 40s[/p][/*][*][p]Third ability usage costs increased:[/p][list][*][p]1st use: Wheat 100, Wood 100 → Wheat 200, Wood 200[/p][/*][*][p]2nd use: Wheat 200, Wood 200 → Wheat 400, Wood 400[/p][/*][*][p]3rd use: Flour 100, Metal 100 → Flour 250, Metal 250[/p][/*][*][p]4th use: Flour 300, Metal 300 → Flour 600, Metal 600[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2][p]We’re actively working on [b]further improvements to quality of life[/b]. Our next focus will be [b]improving the UI[/b] to better explain game mechanics and ensuring that tooltips provide all the information you need at a glance. We’re also planning [b]additional balance changes[/b] based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Devs are Watching[/b][/h2][p]We keep a close eye on [b]discussions, bug reports, and suggestions across all platforms[/b]. Your feedback helps shape the direction of development, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us. You can write us here:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2753900/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/5ZVbHy36Nw"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/TKIWGame"]Twitter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/TheKingIsWatching/"]Reddit[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]~ Hypnohead[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 – Second Royal Decree Now Live!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Noble Kings![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Your diligent royal masons and pest-controlling knights continue their work! Today we deliver the second patch since the game's release. [/p][p][/p][h2]📜Here’s what’s new in Update 1.0.2:[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes and Technical Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that caused the game to close unexpectedly without an error message.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduced the memory leak issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized unit animations, allowing more units on the battlefield while consuming fewer resources from your PC.[/p][/*][*][p]Arachnor's Brother no longer transforms into a different unit after certain encounter decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Russian localization by decreasing text size in some instances, ensuring text remains properly within buttons.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now sell blueprints directly from the trader window.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades for sold blueprints will no longer appear in rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Powerful random seals will now prefer empty tiles rather than tiles already occupied by seals.[/p][/*][/list][p]We are actively working on the [b]highly requested mid-run save feature[/b] and hope to launch public tests for it later this week. Stay tuned for updates! [/p][p][/p][p]Continue sharing your feedback, and join the conversation on our social media:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F5ZVbHy36Nw"][u]Discord[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FTKIWGame"][u]X[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p] Thank you once again for your noble support![/p][p]~Hypnohead [/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is Available Now
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hear ye, hear ye![/b][/p][p]Royal masons have patched up a few cracks in the castle walls, and the foul goblins causing pesky bugs have been chased far beyond the gates![/p][p][b]A huge thank you to all of you, noble kings, for your incredible support!
[/b]Since the game's release earlier this week, you've been setting new records every day for the number of simultaneous rulers in the kingdom, and we’ve been hard at work implementing your feedback and improving the realm.
[/p][h2]📜[b]Here’s what’s included in Update 1.0.1
[/b][/h2][p][b]Bug Fixes and Technical Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash occurring when using the Chinese input method (IME).[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a system to retroactively grant players achievements for previously completed challenges that had not triggered correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the "Lords of Graveyard" challenge would not complete properly.[/p][/*][*][p]King Leonid's initial quest now correctly grants militia, as indicated in the quest description, rather than peasants.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing hunters from applying the slow effect to bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization and resolved issues with text cropping.[/p][/*][*][p]Potentially fixed the Win32 function crash issue; please report if you continue to encounter it.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can now increase game speed during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]When The Graveyard is now unlocked, it unlocks with up to Threat Level 3 available.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced crystal costs for upgrades:[/p][list][*][p]Troops' Damage Levels 1, 2, and 3[/p][/*][*][p]Troops' HP Levels 1, 2, and 3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ascension crystals are now automatically collected when advancing to the next Threat Level.[/p][/*][*][p]The Kings' gaze areas are now displayed on the pre-run screen when hovering over a king.[/p][/*][*][p]Troops' HP and damage popups can now be viewed even when reward notifications are hidden.[/p][/*][/list][p]We are also working on fixing excessive memory usage by the game and introducing in-run save. We hope to release them next week, but everything will depend on the first tests we will run this weekend. [/p][p]
Follow The King is Watching on Social Media:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/5ZVbHy36Nw"][u]Discord[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/TKIWGame"][u]X[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]~Hypnohead[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Your Kingdom starts on July 21st with The King is Watching's Release!
notes.notes: [p]Loyal rulers of the realm, rally your Advisors, dust off your thrones, and ready your eyes: [b]The King is Watching shall release on July 21st![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/21b0f6be034765ebf094b50ebfe8de978c854d06.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The kingdom has grown strong since the days of the first demo. Your liege and his scribes have been hard at work preparing a royal bounty of new content, features, and noble challenges. So lend us your ears (or, we suppose, your eyes), for here’s what awaits you in this full release:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 Into the Graveyard: New Level & Bosses[/b][/h3][p]Brave rulers may now venture into the cursed mists of the [b]Graveyard[/b], a new realm where the dead walk and treasure lies buried![/p][p]But that is not your only peril. Each run now features [b]three powerful bosses[/b], chosen at random from a growing bestiary of 12 deadly enemies, each more dangerous than the last. These formidable enemies will force you to adapt your strategy mid-run, but once defeated, they’ll reward you with new tools and relics to make your reign even stronger![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/6ba41d4cb146ce5c69757d3b8f733670976e4f81.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 New Buildings and Troops[/b][/h3][p][b]New Buildings[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fuel Pump[/b]: Converts wood and water into petrol to power advanced units and structures.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Archmage University[/b]: Casts even mightier spells than your puny wizard towers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tile Enchanter[/b]: After 30 seconds, enchants the tile it’s built on, granting a production bonus for the rest of the run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sacrificial Stone[/b]: Sacrifice Black Sheep units on this ancient stone to receive spell rewards in return.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hero's Statue[/b]: Consumes 200 wood to grant permanent stat upgrades to all your troops.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fisherman's Hub[/b] and [b]Animals Farm[/b]: Gather fresh meat for your more... carnivorous forces.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]New Recruitment Structures for New Troops[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Academy of Nature[/b]: Enroll Healer Mages to boost your arcane army’s vitality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ninja Temple[/b]: Strike your enemies with deadly ninjas.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Druids' Camp of the Bear[/b]: Watch your druids transform into hulking beasts mid-battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lion Circus[/b]: Summon majestic Griffins, airborne terrors at your command.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balloon Bomber[/b]: Recruits a flying Balloon that cannot be attacked, uses petrol to drop bombs damaging multiple enemies. Requires player attention to continue its assault.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firing Range[/b]: Produces Musketeers, reliable Ranged soldiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Geese Training Field[/b]: Trains Goose Riders, powerful Rider/Champion units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goose Hydra Nest[/b]: Mutates a Goose Rider into a terrifying Goose Hydra, a Rider/Arcane unit hungry for enemies (and bread).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive Carts Factory[/b]: Creates carts that explode upon engaging with enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p]As you progress through the game, you’ll gain access to [b]three tiers of buildings[/b], with increasingly rare and powerful options becoming available in later stages of your reign.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/c02b9c14227bc77b2ded3709695fb5b7e20cc4db.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 New Kings & Royal Progressions[/b][/h3][p]Choose from a noble roster of [b]seven monarchs[/b], each with their own [b]unique royal abilities[/b]. Some focus on increasing troop morale, others improve your kingdom’s productivity, and others specialize in unlocking additional magic spells.[/p][p][/p][p]These abilities are unlocked by completing [b]Challenges[/b] that ask each King to prove their worth, such as defeating the first, second, and third bosses using that King in a single run.[/p][p]Want an example?[b] [/b]The first king,[b] King Baldwin, [/b]abilities are:[/p][list][*][p][b]Raise Militia[/b]: Summon 3 Peasants to fight for your cause.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boost Production[/b]: Increases all building production by 40 percent for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Request Tribute[/b]: Grants you 90 resources of your choice.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/1164adfd4eb014456b37fc84dca165f025fab4b3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 Summon the Council: Meet Your Advisors[/b][/h3][p]Before each reign, you may now choose up to [b]8 from 21 Advisors[/b] to serve in your Royal Council. Each brings unique bonuses that alter your path to victory. Rule with the aid of:[/p][list][*][p][b]Gustav[/b]: All building production increased by 5%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phoenix[/b]: 7% chance for fallen troops to rise again.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unicorn[/b]: Gain 3 additional spell slots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Golem[/b]: Building costs are reduced by 10%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Felix the Cat[/b]: Begin your reign with a random powerful artifact.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/39580c15e041d37afde6905879f37c0f1be84dd2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 …And much More![/b][/h3][p]We revealed only a few of the new elements, so stay tuned in the next weeks taking us to release to find out in deeper details what expects your royal kingdom![/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 Prepare Thyself for July 21st![/b][/h3][p]Whether you’re a hardened veteran of the demo or a wide-eyed newcomer, The King is Watching is about to become a true royal campaign of survival, strategy, and glory![/p][p][/p][p]We thank you all for marching alongside us through waves, goblins, and spells. Now, the throne awaits: The King is Watching, and he shall see you on [b]July 21st[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]HUZZAH! 👑[/b][/p]

notes.title: The King is Watching: Release Plans & What’s Coming Next! 👑
notes.notes:
[i][b]Loyal rulers, gather around! [/b][/i]

We are overwhelmed (like by an enemy invasion, but in a good way!) by the sheer amount of feedback we received after Steam Next Fest. Not only have you shared your thoughts and strategies, but over [b]180,000[/b] of you have [b]wishlisted the game[/b]. I would bow to you but the crown would fall (and we don’t want that, do we?)

Our goal today is to share with you what's coming in the 1.0 version. We will also discuss what we want to add to the game after release. To put it simply: [b]more content, more choices, and more ways to rule your kingdom[/b]. With the core of the game polished and stable, we’re expanding and refining it based on your feedback.

[b]Our focus right now is fully on 1.0[/b], but we want to make it clear: this won’t be the end of the journey. While this article is all about what’s coming in the full release, we also plan to continue developing the game beyond launch, [b]so more on that when the time comes![/b]

Let’s dive into the details at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/024d0393165eb727883bc1521fe6dd507a7fb623.gif[/img]

[h2][b]A New King, A New Playstyle[/b][/h2]

The King’s current power is to move blocks across the battlefield. With the release version we will introduce at least one [b]new playable King[/b], each with his own unique powers that [b]evolve the gameplay[/b] and change the way you strategize!

[h2][b]The Royal Council: More Than Just Advisors[/b][/h2]

Advisors will be a major feature in the full game, [b]not just for passive bonuses[/b] but as [b]a way to shape your playthrough[/b]. While the core set of buildings and units remains the same, [b]advisors will determine which blueprints and soldiers you can access[/b], allowing you to avoid those that don’t suit your strategy. Think of them as a way to customize your kingdom’s loadout. Choose wisely, as their influence will define your reign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/f36083c3efb1db1e14d00fabe5219299f45b18c0.png[/img]

[h2][b]Ascension: The Challenge Awaits[/b][/h2]

Think you’ve mastered the kingdom? [b]Think again![/b] Once you finish with the base difficulty, you’ll unlock [b]Ascensions, extra challenge modifiers[/b] that will push even the most seasoned rulers to their limits. Our goal is to have at least [b]7–8 Ascensions[/b], including brutal changes like facing three bosses in a single run instead of two. Now THAT’s a challenge worthy of the most wise Kings!

[h2][b]A New Level: The Undead Rise![/b][/h2]

By 1.0, we’ll be adding [b]at least one more level[/b], and this one comes with a chilling theme: [b]necromancy and the undead[/b]. This cursed land will allow you to mount expeditions to unearth powerful artifacts, all while dealing with new threats, unique bosses, and dark magic. Me? Afraid? Of course not, but we will still look from a safe distance…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/4e07416de235ff43476f995d22bb069a56f57f2d.gif[/img]

[h2][b]More Bosses, More Surprises![/b][/h2]

Currently, the demo has [b]two fixed bosses[/b]… but we want [b]more[/b]! In the full game, your opponent will be [b]randomized[/b] at the start of each run, [b]adding new challenges and twists[/b]. A fortune teller will even forewarn you of the enemy general you’ll face, [b]each one bringing special modifiers to your playthrough[/b]. Some may freeze your buildings. Others will make each wave stronger. And some? They might just resurrect fallen enemies as skeletons. How rude of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/6ba41d4cb146ce5c69757d3b8f733670976e4f81.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Expanded Events System![/b][/h2]

We’re also enhancing our event system to provide clearer resolutions to your choices. Spared an enemy? Had them “removed” from the equation? The consequences of your royal decrees will be spelled out in greater detail, so you’ll always know exactly what fate you’ve sealed!
We’ve also heard your love for the witty, varied events (and their charming illustrations!), so rest assured: more are on the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/8f1cd01e1c5aa872b03d5c7cad80f32fed627086.png[/img]

[h2][b]And Of Course More… Everything![/b][/h2]

Expect [b]tons of additional buildings, units, and spells to expand your tactical options[/b]. This is just a glimpse of what we’re planning, so rest assured, there’s much more to come.

We’ll share more details in future updates, but for now, [b]thank you for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm[/b]. Your kingdom awaits, and the future of [b]The King is Watching[/b] has never looked brighter! [b]HUZZAH![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2981670/The_King_is_Watching_Demo/

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.4
notes.notes:
[b]Loyal subjects, hear ye![/b]

Thanks to everyone who has shared feedback on our discord as well as steamcommunity forums. Update 0.5.4 contains balance changes aimed at buffing underpowered troops and making them more viable. The enemy waves were also rebalanced and are now harder after the 1st boss, yet the late game troops can take care of them. As these troops are much more useful now, there are more builds to play around.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

TROOPS:
[list]
[*] Late game troops are stronger now and are produced faster (and cheaper)
[*] Dragon Boss' HP, damage and fire breath damage are increased. Now he performs his special ability 3 times instead of 2
[/list]

BUILDINGS:
[list]
[*] Late game buildings are cheaper and more obtainable
[/list]

SPELLS:
[list]
[*] The spells unlocked via the upgrade tree are more powerful now
[/list]

ENEMY WAVES
[list]
[*] Waves after the first boss are harder and more tankier. As a result you have to rely more on the quality of your army rather than the damaging spells (spells are still very useful)
[/list]


NEW BUILDINGS UPGRADES:

Stables:
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[/list]
Dragon oven: 
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[*] Increases attack speed by 20%
[/list]
Archery:
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2 (replaced extra attack speed upgrade)
[/list]
Academy of fire:
[list]
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[*] PREVIOUS upgrade reworked: now sets enemies on fire, dealing bonus damage over time
[*] Ballista factory:
[/list]
[list]
[*] Increases damage by 15% and applies slow to enemies shot
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[/list]
Catapult factory:
[list]
[*] Catapults receive 20% chance to stun enemies
[*] Increases troops capacity by 2
[/list]

OTHER:
[list]
[*] Mill and forge can now be found both in Building T1 and T2 upgrades making them more common. Their production speed is also increased by about 50%
[*] Spells are more rare now and the building upgrades are more common among the rewards
[*] Cronenberg unit is now time limited and can no longer be used to spawn an infinite amount of junior cronenbergs
[*] Twin arrows artifact no longer buffs just crossbowmen, now it buffs all of the ranged units, damage boost reduced: 6% -> 3%
[*] Wine excavations now provides 1 wine for each Wheat field or Small wheat field every 10 seconds
[*] Productive and poor tiles are now removed by default. Instead you can unlock 2 productive tiles via the upgrade tree
[/list]

FIXES:
[list]
[*] Some ui fixes improving usability
[*] New branch of the game for the people who experience Win32 function 0x887a0005 CRASH
[*] (has to be in a separate branch as it is a little unstable sometimes)
[/list]
